series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits high spectral entropy (0.9454) and concept drift, indicating unpredictable noise with unstable patterns. A robust baseline strategy (e.g., median aggregation) is recommended to avoid overfitting to transient model performance, while avoiding stacking methods prone to drift sensitivity.

reasoning.robust_median: series_profile.noise.unpredictable=true → high spectral entropy (0.9454) indicates near-white-noise; robust_median is less sensitive to outliers and preferred for unpredictable noise
reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → concept drift is present; ade_dynamic_error adapts to changing model performance with exponential weighting of recent errors
reasoning.topk_mean_per_horizon_k4: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → different models dominate at different horizons; topk_mean_per_horizon captures this structure by averaging top models per horizon

excluded_highlights.stl_hierarchical_stacking_p2_sh0.0: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid contains 'stl_hierarchical_stacking' → explicitly excluded per series_profile instructions
